title: Keyboard Manager - Open app: Enhance Window Selection

status.label: Detailed Keyboard Manager design candidate
status.detail: The request enumerates cycle and already-selected behaviors for Keyboard Manager's Open app action.

next_action.label: Design multi-window Open app behavior
next_action.reason: The desired options and Win+number comparison provide a bounded starting point.

actions.label: Design Open app window cycling
actions.note: Define behavior and settings for multiple running windows and already-selected applications, including repeated shortcut invocation. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The enhancement specifies the target Keyboard Manager action, user-visible options, and repeated-invocation behavior.
evidence: The request extends Keyboard Manager's Open app action when an application is already running.
It proposes a cycle menu comparable to Win+number when multiple windows exist.
It lists expected already-selected behaviors: Windows default, minimize, cycle, or do nothing.
judgment.recommended_action: Design the Open app state model and user settings for multiple windows and repeated activation.
